change.behavior: A null VIEW handle is accepted when its reference and encoded payload are zero and its absolute relation code is 0 or 2 through 5. Non-null handles still require the field's exact expected relation code.
change.publicState: VIEW typed fields and raw handle spans are published through the existing transactional parse path only after successful parsing.

cases: code-4 typed-null baseUcs is accepted and its raw code/span are retained
non-null wrong baseUcs role is rejected without partial publication
corrected typed-null input succeeds on the same parser instance

physicalSampleRecheck.beforeFixTrace: The hash-bound Camera1 VIEW frame failed because its baseUcs handle was raw code 4, target 0, while the parser accepted only canonical null code 0 or the expected non-null role.

afterFixTrace.failure: The bounded frame has no remaining encoded handle for namedUcs; readBoundedObjectHandle fails at that field.
afterFixTrace.specification: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.60 defines both Base UCS Handle and Named UCS Handle for R2000+ VIEW records.
afterFixTrace.decision: Keep the record failure and do not synthesize a missing handle or relax the frame boundary.

physicalSampleRecheck.result: The parser no longer rejects the observed typed-null baseUcs role; the physical sample remains rejected at the absent following namedUcs handle, so BAD_READ_TABLES remains correct for this incomplete profile.
physicalSampleRecheck.separateIntegrityObservation: The reader reports an AC1024 HEADER section envelope discrepancy at file offset 16: expected 816 bytes, observed 820 bytes.
physicalSampleRecheck.softeningExperiment: Temporarily allowing the failed VIEW row to be skipped made the read operation succeed but left one source frame unresolved; the existing sample harness correctly rejected this incomplete coverage. That change was reverted.
physicalSampleRecheck.disposition: Keep physical sample qualification open. The missing namedUcs field and HEADER discrepancy are independent source-integrity gaps.

fixturePolicy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added. The generated profile is encoded in memory.
claimBoundary: This closes only the local typed-null VIEW handle-role parser control. It does not prove target existence, ownership graph closure, whole-file conversion, native VIEW semantics, or broader producer support.
